meta.description: Format and structurally validate local treatment-plan documentation after clinical decisions have already been supplied and verified by authorized licensed professionals. Use for source traceability, clinician-authored intervention records, goals and checkpoints, shared-decision records, reconciliation handoffs, and release gates—not for clinical decision-making.

scientific_integrity.detail: No fabrication; documentation-only scope with no clinical recommendations; all content must be clinician-authored and verified

practice_boundaries.detail: Exceptional safety boundaries: 29 explicit prohibited uses listed; clear scope limited to formatting and validation of pre-existing decisions

methodological_ground.detail: Based on established healthcare documentation standards (FDA labeling, WHO guidance, Joint Commission, AHRQ, NICE) with clear source boundaries

code_usability.detail: Bundled scripts are deterministic, local-only, with no network access, external services, or dynamic execution

functional_suitability.note: Comprehensive coverage of documentation workflow including source traceability, validation, privacy checks, consistency verification, and timeline generation with 6 templates and 6 validation scripts

reliability.note: Outstanding reliability: deterministic local-only validation, comprehensive input rejection rules, no clinical inference, explicit human review requirements, complete provenance tracking

performance_context.note: Well-structured documentation (447 lines) with clear 5-step workflow, comprehensive safety boundaries, and 8 reference files

agent_usability.note: Exceptional safety boundary documentation (29 prohibited uses); clear workflow with explicit gates; comprehensive template and script descriptions; strong provenance requirements

human_usability.note: Clear installation (Python 3.11+ stdlib only); no external dependencies; comprehensive workflow documentation; explicit human review checklist; visible draft notice requirement

security.note: Exceptional security: comprehensive privacy governance section, data gate with 6 conditions for patient data, no external tool usage, synthetic template preference, qualified review requirements

maintainability.note: Outstanding structure with version 2.1, license (MIT), comprehensive reference organization (8 files), dated source ledger, security validation record, clear governance boundaries

agent_specific.note: Excellent composability with deterministic validation; clear integration patterns with authorized systems; comprehensive template structures; minor: could benefit from more explicit output format examples from validation scripts

recommendations.title: Add examples of boundary-crossing requests
recommendations.problem: Prohibited uses listed but users may not recognize subtle boundary crossings
recommendations.root_cause: List is comprehensive but abstract; concrete examples aid recognition
recommendations.fix: Add examples section: 'Boundary-crossing requests include: "Which antibiotic should I use?" (selecting therapy), "Is 10mg appropriate for this patient?" (choosing dose), "Can I give this medication?" (checking contraindications). Instead ask: "Format this clinician-verified prescription record."'

recommendations.title: Add explicit jurisdiction/policy documentation checklist
recommendations.problem: Workflow mentions confirming jurisdiction and local policy but no checklist
recommendations.root_cause: Requirements stated but not operationalized for validation
recommendations.fix: Add to workflow step 1: 'Document in intended_use_handoff_template.json: jurisdiction (state/country), institution name, applicable policies (by title and effective date), responsible department, and compliance review contact'

recommendations.title: Add validation script output format examples
recommendations.problem: Scripts described but output format not shown
recommendations.root_cause: Users may need to understand report structure for automation
recommendations.fix: Add note: 'Validation scripts output JSON or plain text. Example: {"status": "BLOCKED", "findings": [{"rule": "R042", "path": "interventions[2].source", "message": "missing source locator"}]}. Exit code 0 = pass, non-zero = validation failures.'
